sentences.say: On its own, a new iron pot cooks nothing.
The pot lasts for years. Flour, dal and gas run out daily.
So what keeps a community kitchen cooking?
In Lucknow, Dihadi Kitchen has relied on donated rations and money.
sentences.tts: In Lucknow, Dee-haa-dee Kitchen has relied on donated rations and money.

sentences.say: Amritsar's Golden Temple langar uses about thirty gas refills daily.
sentences.tts: Amritsar's Golden Temple lunger uses about thirty gas refills daily.

sentences.say: Staples can be given in kind; fuel usually needs money.
So ask first: staples to drop off, or fuel to fund?
To donate essentials in Lucknow, download Help.
